senses.gloss: Nihelapati (IE 8-3; HD), official designation of uncertain import; probably, the governor of a territorial unit; also spelt Nihilapati. See Vogel, Ant. Ch. St., p. 124; CII, Vol. III, p. 289.
Nihilapati (IE 8-3; CII 3; HD), an official title of uncertain import. See Nihelapati. Cf. CII, Vol. III, p. 289.
